The art of bringing it all together

You live every moment.
We hold every detail.

A wedding is more than the day. It is the welcome, the laughter between events, the right song at the right time. We give the whole weekend a feeling — and a plan.

From first thought to final farewellOne weekend · Six chapters
Friday · 10:00 AM01 / 06
01

Haldi

Friday · 10:00 AM

A little sunshine. A lot of joy.

Marigolds, mischief, and everyone you love. The weekend begins in a courtyard full of colour.

In the plan: shaded seating, a fresh-towel station, and a change of clothes before lunch.
02

Mehendi

Friday · 4:00 PM

Let the afternoon linger.

Henna-dark hands, familiar songs, and stories shared over chai. There is room for the unhurried moments.

In the plan: artist rotations, easy-to-eat plates, and enough time for every intricate detail.
03

Sangeet

Friday · 8:00 PM

The night belongs to everyone.

From the first family performance to the last song nobody wants to end. A celebration with a rhythm of its own.

In the plan: rehearsals, sound checks, performance cues, and a late-night supper.
04

Pheras

Saturday · 5:30 PM

Everything leads to this.

The light softens. The music slows. Seven promises, two families, and a moment held with care.

In the plan: the auspicious hour, guest arrivals, ceremony essentials, and a discreet weather backup.
05

Reception

Saturday · 8:00 PM

One more toast. One more dance.

Dinner beneath warm lights, speeches from the heart, and a dance floor that feels like home.

In the plan: the seating chart, dietary notes, speech timings, and a seamless change of scene.
06

Farewell

Sunday · 10:00 AM

Until we meet again.

A slow breakfast. The last embraces. Everyone carries a little of the weekend home.

In the plan: luggage collection, breakfast boxes, and departures coordinated to the final flight.
